text_block_list.text:
Passing by the plaza, I heard quite a 
commotion. Going over to see what was 
happening—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
...Once more, I grant thee permission to 
speak, Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! See, I'm into collecting titles 
right now. Class-3 Modeling Clay Kneader, 
3-Mat Room Genius Inventor, Honorary 
Lifetime Gleaner, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At this point, every title in the whole 
wide world is basically mine. So here it 
is, Orfèvre— Let's wager the title of 
"King" in a King's Showdown!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, that sounds rather entertaining. 
Now then... Shall we take this 
conversation over there?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
—Nay, elder sister. Slaughtering rebels is 
also the duty of a king.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there. I hereby appoint thee as 
our official witness. Know this to be an 
honor, and devote thyself fully.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Now then, a "King's Showdown," was it? How 
should we proceed—

text_block_list.name: Subjects
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um, Lord Orfe, p-please take this..." 
"My King, pray accept this humble 
offering." "Lord Orfe, I dedicate my 
everything to you...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
What's up with these guys swarming in with 
presents in hand?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
From time to time, those overcome by 
Orfe's royal majesty come bearing gifts 
like this.
choice_data_list:
Being showered with gifts definitely feels 
kingly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ya think~~? Then wouldn't anyone having a 
birthday be a king too?! Are you saying 
Santa can't be a king?!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
...Thou over there. That in thy hands is a 
tribute meant for Us, is it not? Why dost 
thou hesitate to present it?

text_block_list.name: Timid Subject
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um... I-I just thought a handkerchief 
with my clumsy embroidery wasn't w-worthy 
of being a gift to our King...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
It matters not. The moment it rests in Our 
hands, its value is peerless and sacred. 
Now, present it.

text_block_list.name: Timid Subject
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! I am deeply honored!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, spotting someone hiding way in the 
corner like that... Were you a dragonfly 
in your past life?

"Oh, there you are, Golshi—" "We've found 
you, Lord Golshi!!"

text_block_list.name: Squid-Loving Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
When are you gonna pay for that nationwide 
squid fishing tour from the other day?! 
Here's the invoice, and I expect every 
single coin!

text_block_list.name: Creator Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
The Perfect Transforming DX King Yakisoba 
you ordered is complete! Here is the 
invoice. Please settle it promptly.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What... D-Don't want 'em! Stuff like 
that doesn't fit a king!
choice_data_list:
Invoices definitely don't count as 
gifts...

Invoices definitely don't count as 
gifts...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —A king is one who possesses true power.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Audience. Burn the running of your King 
deeply into thine eyes.

text_block_list.name: Defiant Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Hah, acting like a king just 'cause you're 
fast? Seriously hilarious—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Defiant Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
~~~~-gh! ...Dammit. What the hell was that 
surge...?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Drowning out any and all noise in an 
instant... Truly, this is the running of a 
"King."
choice_data_list: Indeed... Wait, what is Gold Ship doing—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Star Light, Shootin' Star, and then— BAM! 
Grand Cross Pose!

text_block_list.name: Onlooker Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
"What are you even doing, Golshi?!" "Hurry 
up and run!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Silence! I'm currently gathering cosmic 
power through Galaxy Yoga—LET'S GALAXY!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
HYA-HAHA! It's here, it's here! Full blast 
to the edge of the galaxy!

text_block_list.name: Onlooker Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
So fast! How can she generate that much 
speed with such a ridiculous form?!

—In the end, Orfèvre took total victory in 
the King's Showdown... or rather, it was 
questionable if it could even be called a 
proper contest. However—

text_block_list.name: Onlooker Horse Girls
text_block_list.text:
"Makes zero sense, but man, she's 
hilarious!" "Never a dull moment watching 
Golshi, she's the best~"

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
A foolish king draws no followers. Perhaps 
the power to magnetically draw people in 
is also the caliber of a king.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Unexpectedly, she might make for a rather 
delightful ruler—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ruler? Hah, no way in hell I'm doing 
something that tedious!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Doing high-and-mighty surveillance duties 
and disciplining snappy little puppies... 
Only a total lunatic like you would 
actually enjoy doing that stuff.
choice_data_list:
...Wait, if you listen closely, is that a 
compliment?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Indeed. Keeping a wide watch and 
guiding others along a righteous path—at 
the very least, she seems to understand 
the qualities a king must possess.
choice_data_list:
Maybe she really could become a great 
king.

She could just say it a bit more 
straightforwardly.

Are you still continuing this "King's 
Showdown"?

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, not happening. All I wanted 
was the title of King... Wait a second, 
why did I even want that junk in the first 
place?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Who needs some stuffy title! Just the name 
"Gold Ship" is plenty!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~, that's like, totally hurtful? 
Besides, I'm like super bored of the whole 
king thing anyway, so go ahead and do 
whatever ya want~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Duh, of course! Golshi-chan's grand 
adventure has only just begun!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Grab a nice stick and assemble at the food 
court! To celebrate the founding of the 
Golshi Land Pirates, we toast with sweet 
red bean soup!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...Or so I'd love to say, but the backlash 
from that yoga earlier is making retail 
prices for shishito peppers skyrocket!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
At this rate, the tempura joints are gonna 
take a massive hit. So for today, I gotta 
vanish like a ninja!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, shall we settle this? The 
ultimate game to decide the true King—The 
Golshi-chan Style King's Game!
